subject.title: Feature: enrich usage/status JSON with agent, cron, and channel labels

question: Which official JSON surface should own stable agent/cron/channel attribution for usage rows, and what privacy-safe field set should OpenClaw commit to?
rationale: Current code has a partial per-session gateway surface, but the issue asks to expand a public JSON contract and possibly `status --usage --json`, which requires maintainer intent on API shape and privacy behavior.

options.title: Enrich sessions.usage first
options.body: Make `sessions.usage` the canonical per-session attribution API, add the missing cron/session kind/runtime fields there, and document status JSON as provider-usage-only unless a later decision expands it.

options.title: Add status JSON rows too
options.body: Add a new per-session usage section to `openclaw status --usage --json` in addition to `sessions.usage`, accepting the larger CLI compatibility and docs surface.

options.title: Defer stable attribution
options.body: Keep the issue open as product input and continue relying on current `sessions.usage` partial metadata plus local adapters until the telemetry contract is prioritized.

recommendation.title: Enrich sessions.usage first
recommendation.body: Make `sessions.usage` the canonical per-session attribution API, add the missing cron/session kind/runtime fields there, and document status JSON as provider-usage-only unless a later decision expands it.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses Gateway protocol, CLI status, docs, and product API boundaries that recent history most strongly associates with this owner path.
